Three.js 0.170.0, vendored from the official `three` npm package.

`three.module.js` is the unmodified `build/three.module.min.js` release build,
stored under a stable local filename. `OrbitControls.js` differs only
in its `three` import, which points at the local release build. The MIT license
is included in `LICENSE`. The simulator makes no third-party runtime requests.
